steps.command:
set -e; ip addr flush dev r1-eth0; ip addr add 10.0.12.1/30 dev r1-eth0; ip addr add 10.1.1.1/32 dev lo; ip link set lo up; ip link set r1-eth0 up; sysctl -qw net.ipv4.ip_forward=1; d=/var/run/frr/mnr-bgp-r1; mkdir -p $d /etc/frr/mnr-bgp-r1; : > /etc/frr/mnr-bgp-r1/vtysh.conf; chown frr:frr $d; chmod 775 $d; printf 'hostname r1
log file %s/zebra-runtime.log
' "$d" > $d/zebra.conf; printf 'hostname r1
log file %s/bgpd-runtime.log
router bgp 65001
 bgp router-id 1.1.1.1
 no bgp ebgp-requires-policy
 neighbor 10.0.12.2 remote-as 65002
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 10.1.1.1/32
 exit-address-family
' "$d" > $d/bgpd.conf; /usr/lib/frr/zebra -d -N mnr-bgp-r1 -f $d/zebra.conf -i $d/zebra.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/zebra.log 2>&1; /usr/lib/frr/bgpd -d -N mnr-bgp-r1 -f $d/bgpd.conf -i $d/bgpd.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/bgpd.log 2>&1

set -e; ip addr flush dev r2-eth0; ip addr add 10.0.12.2/30 dev r2-eth0; ip addr add 10.2.2.2/32 dev lo; ip link set lo up; ip link set r2-eth0 up; sysctl -qw net.ipv4.ip_forward=1; d=/var/run/frr/mnr-bgp-r2; mkdir -p $d /etc/frr/mnr-bgp-r2; : > /etc/frr/mnr-bgp-r2/vtysh.conf; chown frr:frr $d; chmod 775 $d; printf 'hostname r2
log file %s/zebra-runtime.log
' "$d" > $d/zebra.conf; printf 'hostname r2
log file %s/bgpd-runtime.log
router bgp 65002
 bgp router-id 2.2.2.2
 no bgp ebgp-requires-policy
 neighbor 10.0.12.1 remote-as 65001
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 10.2.2.2/32
 exit-address-family
' "$d" > $d/bgpd.conf; /usr/lib/frr/zebra -d -N mnr-bgp-r2 -f $d/zebra.conf -i $d/zebra.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/zebra.log 2>&1; /usr/lib/frr/bgpd -d -N mnr-bgp-r2 -f $d/bgpd.conf -i $d/bgpd.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/bgpd.log 2>&1
vtysh -N mnr-bgp-r1 -c 'show bgp summary' | awk '$1 == "10.0.12.2" && $10 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { found=1; print; } END { exit !found }'
